svg.aria-label: Inside a DSA layer: the indexer scores every query against every earlier pool, so its cost is quadratic, while sparse attention reads only k tokens per query, so its cost is linear.
svg.text: Inside a DSA layer: sparse attention, dense indexer
The indexer picks which earlier tokens each query attends to, and the attention then reads only
those. But to pick them, the indexer scores every query against every earlier pool of 4 tokens.
every query scores every earlier pool
each query reads at most k tokens
The quadratic cost moved into the indexer
Sparse attention scales with S·k, but the indexer's scoring still scales with S²
